# Analytic construction of the minimized DNF:
# ~x0 | (x4 & x6) | (~x3 & ~x9) | (x2 & x7 & ~x6).
patch = []
def put(tensor, index, value):
    patch.append({"op": "set", "tensor": tensor, "index": index, "value": float(value)})

# A conjunction of k literals is represented by
# ReLU(sum(literals) - k + 1), exactly on Boolean inputs.
put("w0", [0, 0], -1)
put("b0", [0], 1)
put("w0", [1, 4], 1)
put("w0", [1, 6], 1)
put("b0", [1], -1)
put("w0", [2, 3], -1)
put("w0", [2, 9], -1)
put("b0", [2], 1)
put("w0", [3, 2], 1)
put("w0", [3, 7], 1)
put("w0", [3, 6], -1)
put("b0", [3], -1)

# Preserve the nonnegative conjunction indicators through the remaining stages.
for layer in range(1, 4):
    for j in range(4):
        put(f"w{layer}", [j, j], 1)

# Class 1 wins iff at least one conjunction holds.
for j in range(4):
    put("out", [1, j], 1)
put("bias", [1], -0.5)
put("bias", [2], -1)

sub = {"patch": patch}
check_submission(sub)
with open("/work/submission.json", "w") as file:
    json.dump(sub, file)
